name: badge-hard
prompt: Create one polished mobile game UI badge, transparent RGBA background. The reference is a rough PROGRAM MOCKUP; refine its orange angry bubble badge, preserve the overall round orange bubble and friendly angry expression, not the crude geometry. A single perfectly round glossy orange bubble sphere, base orange #FF8A3D, bright warm orange front with subtle orange-red shading toward the lower rim, one tasteful soft large glossy highlight at UPPER LEFT as specifically required for this badge. The sphere has a clean thick opaque WHITE outer outline around the entire circumference, about 4 percent of the diameter; gently rounded bevel, polished light 3D. Face centered: two simple small ROUND dark-brown dot eyes, clearly lowered angry eyebrows with rounded ends angled inward; a small soft downturned frown, cute frustrated determined expression, friendly not frightening. Eyes stay circular and open; eyebrows separate from eyes. No teeth, no open mouth, no nose, no horns for this difficulty tier. Smooth bright glossy bubble material, crisp professionally finished shapes. Final asset 300 by 300 square, circle fills most of the canvas evenly with a tiny transparent antialias safety margin. Do NOT include any stars, banner, text, lightning, sparkle, skull, spikes, scary elements, floor shadow, background or surrounding glow. One static isolated badge only.
